# Wilson & McQueen PLLC

> > Wilson & McQueen PLLC is a Kentucky personal injury law firm serving Lexington, London, Georgetown, Richmond, and Nicholasville with expertise in car accidents, medical malpractice, workers' compensation, and wrongful death claims.

The firm specializes in Kentucky no-fault insurance law, Personal Injury Protection (PIP) claims, and representing injured workers and accident victims throughout Central and Eastern Kentucky. Their practice emphasizes client education through comprehensive FAQs and legal guidance on insurance coverage, liability, and compensation.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Protection (PIP)
- Kentucky No-Fault Insurance
- Medical Malpractice
- Workers' Compensation
- Car Accident Claims
- Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist Coverage
- Wrongful Death
- Product Liability
- Driver Negligence
- Motorcycle Accidents
- Distracted Driving
- Workplace Injuries
- Forensic Evidence
- Kentucky Insurance Law
- Accident Compensation
